requirement:
The coverage check MUST fail when no usable coverage has been collected, or when
a selected latest attempt has missing, unreadable, or stale coverage. It MUST
distinguish these measurement failures from measured lines with zero execution
and from individual functions absent from otherwise usable coverage. Exception
evidence MUST NOT excuse measurement failures or permit substitution of an
older attempt. Excluded historical runs and incompatible configurations MUST
NOT by themselves cause failure.

Coverage whose format does not support the function attribution required by
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.functions` MUST be rejected with guidance
to recollect coverage. When missing or corrupt metadata prevents establishing
the latest-per-test selection or active configuration, the check MUST fail
rather than silently use remaining records. Historical data MAY be disregarded
without failure only when its exclusion can be established.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation of `requirements.test-coverage.check.measurement`. All of them are in `src/execution_coverage/check.rs` under `mod[tests]`.

- **No usable coverage, or a selected latest attempt that is missing or stale.**
  - `fn[stale_missing_legacy_and_uncertain_history_cannot_use_older_success]` starts with no records and asserts the report fails. It then records a good attempt and asserts it passes.
  - It then adds a newer attempt whose `profile.profraw` is deleted and asserts the report says "missing or unreadable". An older good attempt does not rescue it, so older-attempt substitution is ruled out.
  - It then makes the source stale and asserts "stale coverage".
  - A newer fresh attempt then makes the report pass again, even though attempts 2 to 4 are bad. Superseded historical attempts therefore do not cause failure.
- **Legacy format.** The same test, and the "legacy" case in `fn[accepted_exceptions_cannot_waive_invalid_measurement_and_checks_still_collect_errors]`, assert the "lacks function attribution" and "recollect coverage with this Habeas version" guidance.
- **Corrupt metadata.**
  - A corrupt `run.json` produces "cannot establish latest-per-test", checked in `fn[stale_missing_legacy_and_uncertain_history_cannot_use_older_success]`.
  - The "corrupt history" case in the exceptions test also fails the report.
  - The "corrupt counters" and "empty lines" cases assert "corrupt function attribution" and "No usable instrumented lines".
  - Only `run.json` corruption is exercised in this file. Failures from `attempt.json` or the storage directory are not tested here. I judged that acceptable because they all set the same `uncertain_history` flag, which the `run.json` case already asserts.
- **Excluded or incompatible history does not fail.** In `fn[stale_missing_legacy_and_uncertain_history_cannot_use_older_success]`, an "other-config" attempt with no function attribution is recorded and the report still passes ("excluded legacy data cannot invalidate a supported active configuration").
- **Exceptions cannot excuse measurement failures.** `fn[accepted_exceptions_cannot_waive_invalid_measurement_and_checks_still_collect_errors]` runs seven failure kinds: absent, missing profile, legacy, corrupt counters, stale, corrupt history and empty lines. Each has accepted file and function citations. Each must fail, must not show "accepted exception", and must not show a "0/1 (0.0%)" measurement.
- **Measurement failures versus zero execution or an absent function.**
  - `fn[accepted_file_and_function_explanations_remain_separate_from_execution]` asserts "zero execution" for measured zero lines. It asserts "not measured" for an absent function and for an unmeasured file.
  - `fn[unmeasured_executable_files_and_parse_failures_do_not_disappear]` asserts "not measured — FAIL" and "#fn[missing]: not measured".
  - `fn[readable_failed_execution_can_contribute_but_outcomes_remain_visible]` shows a readable failed attempt still contributes. A reported process diagnostic then fails the check.

I found no gap in the tests for this requirement, and no acknowledgments apply.

text: :::{req} check.measurement
The coverage check MUST fail when no usable coverage has been collected, or when
a selected latest attempt has missing, unreadable, or stale coverage. It MUST
distinguish these measurement failures from measured lines with zero execution
and from individual functions absent from otherwise usable coverage. Exception
evidence MUST NOT excuse measurement failures or permit substitution of an
older attempt. Excluded historical runs and incompatible configurations MUST
NOT by themselves cause failure.
Coverage whose format does not support the function attribution required by
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.functions` MUST be rejected with guidance
to recollect coverage. When missing or corrupt metadata prevents establishing
the latest-per-test selection or active configuration, the check MUST fail
rather than silently use remaining records. Historical data MAY be disregarded
without failure only when its exclusion can be established.
:::{req} check.functions
Every function under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.scope` without
recorded execution attributable to it MUST have current accepted exception
evidence under {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.exceptions`, even when
its containing file meets the target of
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.check.threshold`.
Execution attributable only to another function, including a nested function
or closure, MUST NOT establish coverage of the enclosing function merely
because their source locations overlap. Having no recorded lines alone MUST
NOT establish that a function has no executable coverage obligations.
